note: Chapter 2 (C2-01 to C2-09) from docs/chapter-02/CHAPTER_02_PRODUCTION.md section 5. Human lines are overheard; humans can't see or hear the spirits.

bs01_south_closed.speaker: narrator
bs01_south_closed.text: Steps lead down past the station toward the sound of water.

bs01_south_closed.speaker: reno
bs01_south_closed.text: Later! We've got a train to catch first.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: narrator
C2_01_arrive.text: Night at the river below Bandar Senja. The water is flowing uphill, past the jetty, the wrong way.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: fisherman
C2_01_arrive.text: (to his friend) Third night running. Nets come up full of old things. A spoon from my grandmother's house!

C2_01_arrive.speaker: fisher_friend
C2_01_arrive.text: The tide tables must be printed wrong.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: fisherman
C2_01_arrive.text: Tide tables don't make spoons.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: reno
C2_01_arrive.text: The water's going the wrong way! Is it lost?

C2_01_arrive.speaker: lumi
C2_01_arrive.text: Rivers don't get lost.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: narrator
C2_01_arrive.text: Two kingfisher spirits flash down and land on the rail, one blue, one teal.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilat
C2_01_arrive.text: You're the train kids—

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilau
C2_01_arrive.text: —with the Conductor's whistle!

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilat
C2_01_arrive.text: I'm Kilat. That's Kilau. Nenek Arus needs—

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilau
C2_01_arrive.text: —help. She's the river's guardian, and she's forgetting the Tide Song.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilat
C2_01_arrive.text: Without the song the river can't remember—

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilau
C2_01_arrive.text: —which way is home.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: lumi
C2_01_arrive.text: Where do we find it?

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilat
C2_01_arrive.text: Three verses. Pak Lumpur in the Mangrove Walk has one, east of here—

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilau
C2_01_arrive.text: —Old Pole in Kampung Air has another. And the last one sank with the old jetty.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilat
C2_01_arrive.text: Oh! The carved posts in the mangroves are tide markers. Blow your whistle at one—

C2_01_arrive.speaker: kilau
C2_01_arrive.text: —and hum what we sing. Listen: hoo-ee, hoo-oo.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: reno
C2_01_arrive.text: Hoo-ee, hoo-oo. Got it.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: lumi
C2_01_arrive.text: You sang it flat.

C2_01_arrive.speaker: narrator
C2_01_arrive.text: New goal: find the three verses of the Tide Song.

kingfishers_hint.speaker: kilat
kingfishers_hint.text: You have all three! Talk to us—

kingfishers_hint.speaker: kilat
kingfishers_hint.text: The boat's waiting at the end of the pier—

kingfishers_hint.speaker: kilau
kingfishers_hint.text: —it won't wait forever. Well. It might.

kingfishers_hint.speaker: kilat
kingfishers_hint.text: Look at the river! The right way round—

kingfishers_hint.speaker: kilat
kingfishers_hint.text: Old Pole is in Kampung Air, past the mangroves—

kingfishers_hint.speaker: kilau
kingfishers_hint.text: —he only lets Lumi hear him properly.

kingfishers_hint.speaker: kilat
kingfishers_hint.text: Two verses! The last one is at the Sunken Jetty, past Kampung Air—

kingfishers_hint.speaker: kilat
kingfishers_hint.text: Pak Lumpur's island is east, in the Mangrove Walk—

kingfishers_hint.speaker: kilau
kingfishers_hint.text: —blow the whistle at the carved posts. High tide, low tide!

human_rv_fisherman.speaker: fisherman
human_rv_fisherman.text: (muttering, mending a net) A toy boat. A bicycle bell. My neighbour's wedding ring, gone ten years. The river took them all back out again.

human_rv_fisherman.speaker: fisherman
human_rv_fisherman.text: (to his friend) I put a box out. If anything washes up, it goes in there. Somebody might want it.

human_rv_fisherman.speaker: reno
human_rv_fisherman.text: He can't hear us. Still weird.

human_rv_fisherman.speaker: lumi
human_rv_fisherman.text: Lost things... we've seen some of those glinting around the river.

human_rv_friend.speaker: fisher_friend
human_rv_friend.text: (to the fisherman) My father said the river ran backwards once before. Nobody believed him either.

C2_02_mangrove.speaker: narrator
C2_02_mangrove.text: Mangrove roots knot over the water. A strip of mud runs east, then disappears into a deep channel.

C2_02_mangrove.speaker: lumi
C2_02_mangrove.text: Look, a carved post. Wave lines, like the kingfishers said.

C2_02_mangrove.speaker: reno
C2_02_mangrove.text: A tide marker! Let's try the whistle.

C2_02_tide_call.speaker: narrator
C2_02_tide_call.text: Reno blows the Conductor's Whistle on the last note. Far off, the river answers.

C2_02_tide_call.speaker: narrator
C2_02_tide_call.text: Learned Tide Call! At a tide marker, press A to switch between low and high tide.

C2_02_tide_call.speaker: narrator
C2_02_tide_call.text: The water rises. The mud path is gone and logs bob up in the deep channel.

C2_02_tide_call.speaker: reno
C2_02_tide_call.text: We can boss the river around now?

C2_02_tide_call.speaker: lumi
C2_02_tide_call.text: We can ask the river nicely. Blow again and it goes back down.

tide_toggle.speaker: narrator
tide_toggle.text: Reno blows the whistle. Hoo-ee, hoo-oo.

tide_toggle.speaker: narrator
tide_toggle.text: High tide. Mud paths sink and logs float up in the deep channel.

tide_toggle.speaker: narrator
tide_toggle.text: Low tide. The water slides away and the mud paths show again.

pz201_crossed.speaker: reno
pz201_crossed.text: Made it! And only one shoe is muddy.

C2_02_lumpur.speaker: pak_lumpur
C2_02_lumpur.text: Low water, show the... show the... ah, no. Start again. Low water...

C2_02_lumpur.speaker: lumi
C2_02_lumpur.text: Pak Lumpur? The kingfishers sent us. We're collecting the Tide Song for Nenek Arus.

C2_02_lumpur.speaker: pak_lumpur
C2_02_lumpur.text: Visitors! On my island! Nobody crosses the channel anymore. The tide's gone silly.

C2_02_lumpur.speaker: pak_lumpur
C2_02_lumpur.text: I keep losing my place. You hum along, little one, and maybe I'll get to the end.

C2_02_lumpur.speaker: pak_lumpur
C2_02_lumpur.text: (singing) Low water, show the way. High water, carry home. ...There! The whole verse!

C2_02_lumpur.speaker: pak_lumpur
C2_02_lumpur.text: Old Pole in Kampung Air remembers the next one. East, through the roots.

lumpur_after.speaker: pak_lumpur
lumpur_after.text: Low water, show the way... I remember it now. Mostly. Kampung Air is east!

rv02_lumpur_calls.speaker: pak_lumpur
rv02_lumpur_calls.text: Wait, wait! Nobody leaves my island without hearing my verse!

rv02_tangle_beaten.speaker: reno
rv02_tangle_beaten.text: It was just an old net. A really grabby old net.

rv02_wisps_beaten.speaker: lumi
rv02_wisps_beaten.text: Silt. Stirred up from the bottom. The river's upset.

C2_03_village.speaker: narrator
C2_03_village.text: Kampung Air on the spirit side: stilt houses of driftwood and reeds, lanterns made from snail shells.

C2_03_village.speaker: reno
C2_03_village.text: A whole village on the water! Do they ever fall in?

C2_03_village.speaker: lumi
C2_03_village.text: They're river spirits, Reno. Falling in is the point.

C2_03_village.speaker: narrator
C2_03_village.text: At the top of a jetty walk stands a very old post, wrapped in rope and barnacles. It seems to be listening.

pole_reno.speaker: old_pole
pole_reno.text: Mmm... a song? Yes. I remember it like warm water. But the words...

pole_reno.speaker: reno
pole_reno.text: He remembers it as a feeling. Lumi, can your Memory Touch reach that?

pole_reno.speaker: narrator
pole_reno.text: (Swap to Lumi with C, then talk to Old Pole again.)

C2_03_old_pole.speaker: narrator
C2_03_old_pole.text: Lumi rests her hand on the old wood. Memory Touch.

C2_03_old_pole.speaker: narrator
C2_03_old_pole.text: Lanterns on the water. A festival, long ago. Many voices singing from boats and doorways, all together.

C2_03_old_pole.speaker: narrator
C2_03_old_pole.text: The memory fades. Lumi is humming the tune before she notices.

C2_03_old_pole.speaker: old_pole
C2_03_old_pole.text: Oh... oh. You sound like an echo of someone who sang to this river once.

C2_03_old_pole.speaker: reno
C2_03_old_pole.text: SO! That verse! Very nice verse! Lots of words in it!

C2_03_old_pole.speaker: narrator
C2_03_old_pole.text: Lumi's humming spreads out in rings. She learned Ripple Echo! (6 MP, hits every enemy.)

C2_03_old_pole.speaker: old_pole
C2_03_old_pole.text: The last verse sank with the old jetty, east of here. The bell there won't stop ringing over it.

pole_after.speaker: old_pole
pole_after.text: Many voices, one river. Thank you for remembering with me.

siput_stall.speaker: mak_siput
siput_stall.text: Slow down, slow down. Nothing good was ever sold in a hurry.

then.speaker: mak_siput
then.text: I'll be here. I'm always here. It takes me a week to leave.

kampung_spirit_a.speaker: river_spirit
kampung_spirit_a.text: The tide used to come in with the song. Now it comes in whenever it feels like it.

kampung_spirit_b.speaker: river_spirit
kampung_spirit_b.text: My cousin drifted upriver last night. Backwards! She was furious.

tackle_box_idle.speaker: narrator
tackle_box_idle.text: The fisherman's tackle box. Hooks, string, and a space he's keeping clear for lost things.

place_toy_boat.speaker: narrator
place_toy_boat.text: Quick, while he's looking at the water: Reno slips the toy boat into the tackle box.

place_toy_boat.speaker: narrator
place_toy_boat.text: The fisherman turns back and stares into the box.

place_toy_boat.speaker: fisherman
place_toy_boat.text: (to himself) A boat? My son sailed one like this in the monsoon drain. ...He'll laugh.

place_bell.speaker: narrator
place_bell.text: Quick, while he's looking at the water: Reno slips the bicycle bell into the tackle box.

place_bell.speaker: narrator
place_bell.text: The fisherman turns back and stares into the box.

place_bell.speaker: fisherman
place_bell.text: (to himself) Ting! Ha. That's the one from the postman's old bicycle.

place_ring.speaker: narrator
place_ring.text: Quick, while he's looking at the water: Reno slips the wedding ring into the tackle box.

place_ring.speaker: narrator
place_ring.text: The fisherman turns back and stares into the box.

place_ring.speaker: fisherman
place_ring.text: (to himself) ...Mak Yam's ring. Ten years. I'll walk it over to her myself.

lost_reaction.speaker: lumi
lost_reaction.text: That's all three. The river gave them back, really. We just carried them.

find_toy_boat.speaker: narrator
find_toy_boat.text: A little wooden toy boat, stuck in the roots.

find_toy_boat.speaker: reno
find_toy_boat.text: That's one of the fisherman's lost things! Let's put it in his box.

find_bell.speaker: narrator
find_bell.text: A rusty bicycle bell, caught on a stilt.

find_bell.speaker: reno
find_bell.text: That's one of the fisherman's lost things! Let's put it in his box.

find_ring.speaker: narrator
find_ring.text: Something gold, half buried in the mud. A wedding ring.

find_ring.speaker: reno
find_ring.text: That's one of the fisherman's lost things! Let's put it in his box.

rv03_jetty_not_yet.speaker: old_pole
rv03_jetty_not_yet.text: (calling from up the walk) Little ones! Don't go out to the jetty without the song in your heads. Come and see me first.

C2_04_jetty.speaker: narrator
C2_04_jetty.text: The old ferry jetty. Half of it has sunk. Out past the gap, a bell is clanging over and over from a flooded bell house.

C2_04_jetty.speaker: reno
C2_04_jetty.text: The boardwalk's broken. And the far side is way up there.

C2_04_jetty.speaker: lumi
C2_04_jetty.text: At low tide the deck is too high. At high tide we'd float up level with it... if we had something to float on.

C2_04_jetty.speaker: reno
C2_04_jetty.text: Those crates down in the mud! I can pull them with Root Grip.

C2_04_jetty.speaker: narrator
C2_04_jetty.text: (Low tide: Root Grip two crates into the gap. High tide: they float, and you can walk across. The rope by the entrance puts everything back.)

rv04_tide_toggle.speaker: narrator
rv04_tide_toggle.text: Reno blows the whistle. Hoo-ee, hoo-oo.

rv04_tide_toggle.speaker: narrator
rv04_tide_toggle.text: High tide. The mud flat floods. Anything wooden bobs up.

rv04_tide_toggle.speaker: narrator
rv04_tide_toggle.text: Low tide. The water drains off the mud flat.

rv04_reset.speaker: narrator
rv04_reset.text: A rope tied to the old jetty post. Pull it to put the crates back where they were?

rv04_crab_beaten.speaker: reno
rv04_crab_beaten.text: Its claws were mostly rust. Mostly.

rv04_deck_beaten.speaker: lumi
rv04_deck_beaten.text: Everything out here is tangled up in something.

C2_04_bell_intro.speaker: narrator
C2_04_bell_intro.text: In the flooded bell house, a great bell crusted with barnacles swings by itself. CLANG. CLANG. CLANG.

C2_04_bell_intro.speaker: lumi
C2_04_bell_intro.text: Excuse me! We're looking for a verse of the Tide Song!

C2_04_bell_intro.speaker: barnacle_bell
C2_04_bell_intro.text: CLANG! Can't stop! If it goes quiet I'll forget! CLANG!

C2_04_bell_intro.speaker: reno
C2_04_bell_intro.text: It's ringing right over the verse. We have to make it stop.

C2_04_bell_outro.speaker: narrator
C2_04_bell_outro.text: The Barnacle Bell slows. Swings. Stops. The quiet is enormous.

C2_04_bell_outro.speaker: barnacle_bell
C2_04_bell_outro.text: ...If I stop ringing, I'll forget I was ever a bell.

C2_04_bell_outro.speaker: barnacle_bell
C2_04_bell_outro.text: (very softly) ...Every tide comes back. That's the verse. That's the one I was keeping. Take it.

C2_04_bell_outro.speaker: barnacle_bell
C2_04_bell_outro.text: And take this. It's soggy. I won't need it to be quiet.

C2_04_bell_outro.speaker: narrator
C2_04_bell_outro.text: Got the Soggy Bell Clapper. Reno wears it: DEF +3.

C2_04_bell_outro.speaker: reno
C2_04_bell_outro.text: All three verses! Back to the Kingfishers!

C2_04_bell_outro.speaker: lumi
C2_04_bell_outro.text: There's a little skiff tied up by the back wall. It'll take us to Kampung Air.

C2_05_tide_song.speaker: kilau
C2_05_tide_song.text: —sing it! Sing it here, where the ferry used to come in!

C2_05_tide_song.speaker: narrator
C2_05_tide_song.text: Lumi stands at the end of the pier and sings. Reno lifts the whistle.

choice.text: Blow the whistle on the beat

C2_05_tide_song.speaker: lumi
C2_05_tide_song.text: High water, carry home. Many voices, one river...

choice.text: Blow the whistle on the beat
Blow the whistle on the beat

C2_05_tide_song.speaker: narrator
C2_05_tide_song.text: The river holds its breath. Then, out of the dark water, a boat rises: long and quiet, with a lantern at each end and nobody rowing.

C2_05_tide_song.speaker: fisherman
C2_05_tide_song.text: (to his friend) Did you see that ripple? Like something big turned over.

C2_05_tide_song.speaker: fisher_friend
C2_05_tide_song.text: Fish. Big fish. Let's go home.

C2_05_tide_song.speaker: kilat
C2_05_tide_song.text: The Veil boat! It goes down to the Drowned Crossing—

C2_05_tide_song.speaker: kilau
C2_05_tide_song.text: —that's where the Undertow is. Be careful!

C2_05_tide_song.speaker: narrator
C2_05_tide_song.text: New goal: ride the Veil boat to the Drowned Crossing.

board_veil_boat.speaker: narrator
board_veil_boat.text: The Veil boat waits at the end of the pier, lanterns glowing.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: The boat sinks gently under the water. The air stays dry.

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: We should be ready first. The Undertow is strong.

C2_06_crossing.speaker: narrator
C2_06_crossing.text: The old ferry crossing lies on the riverbed. Lost things circle slowly overhead: nets, sandals, a bicycle wheel, letters with the ink run.

C2_06_crossing.speaker: lumi
C2_06_crossing.text: Everything the river lost ends up here.

C2_06_crossing.speaker: narrator
C2_06_crossing.text: In the middle, all of it knots together into one dark, turning shape.

C2_06_undertow_intro.speaker: undertow
C2_06_undertow_intro.text: Keep. Everything. Nothing floats away if I keep it all.

C2_06_undertow_intro.speaker: lumi
C2_06_undertow_intro.text: It's not angry. It's scared of losing things. ...So are we, a bit.

C2_06_undertow_intro.speaker: undertow
C2_06_undertow_intro.text: Then STAY. Stay and be kept!

C2_07_calmed.speaker: narrator
C2_07_calmed.text: The Undertow sags. Lumi steps forward and sings the whole Tide Song, all three verses, slow and clear.

C2_07_calmed.speaker: lumi
C2_07_calmed.text: Low water, show the way. High water, carry home. Many voices, one river. Every tide comes back.

C2_07_calmed.speaker: narrator
C2_07_calmed.text: The knot loosens. One by one the lost things drift up toward the surface, toward the people who lost them.

C2_07_calmed.speaker: narrator
C2_07_calmed.text: The current turns. Somewhere upstream, a guardian's pool begins to fill.

C2_08_nenek_arus.speaker: narrator
C2_08_nenek_arus.text: A still pool where the river begins to turn the right way. An old spirit made of reflections sits at its edge, reeds in her hair. She is pale, and fading at the edges.

C2_08_nenek_arus.speaker: nenek_arus
C2_08_nenek_arus.text: Thank you, little ones. My river remembers its way again. But I still don't feel whole.

C2_08_nenek_arus.speaker: narrator
C2_08_nenek_arus.text: She turns, and they see it: a page-shaped hole in her reflection, its edge as straight as a ruler.

C2_08_nenek_arus.speaker: nenek_arus
C2_08_nenek_arus.text: Someone cut part of my name from the Book. Neatly. With ink on their fingers. Names don't fall out by themselves.

C2_08_nenek_arus.speaker: nenek_arus
C2_08_nenek_arus.text: Someone who wants the worlds to stop touching. Follow the ink. It smelled of a town that trades in paper: Bandar Kencana.

C2_08_nenek_arus.speaker: nenek_arus
C2_08_nenek_arus.text: And you, little singer. Your humming is an old echo. Keep it safe.

C2_08_nenek_arus.speaker: nenek_arus
C2_08_nenek_arus.text: Take this. It will hum the song when you need it.

C2_08_nenek_arus.speaker: narrator
C2_08_nenek_arus.text: The pool's light grows, and grows, until it is simply morning.

C2_09_morning.speaker: narrator
C2_09_morning.text: Dawn at Senja River Landing. The river runs the right way.

C2_09_morning.speaker: fisherman
C2_09_morning.text: (on the jetty rail, holding up a spoon) My grandmother's spoon! Who put this here? ...Never mind. Never mind!

C2_09_morning.speaker: fisher_friend
C2_09_morning.text: (laughing) The river's giving things back now?

C2_09_morning.speaker: reno
C2_09_morning.text: Bandar Kencana. Do they have trains?
